title: 2023 Investor Day | Tesla
summary: Tesla's 2023 Investor Day, a nearly four-hour presentation covering Master Plan 3, vehicle design, powertrain, electronic architecture, manufacturing and sustainable energy economics.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for Tesla's claims on battery materials, assembly design, 48V architecture and energy investment.

quote.text: I recommend watching the original presentation by Tesla's lead designer from Investor Day, it's about 12 mins and has great visuals
